aboutHero.headline: A Place for
aboutHero.subline: Cancer Herbalist is an institute in Bengaluru, India sharing information about botanical products, herbal nutrition and complementary wellness for people affected by cancer. We encourage patients and caregivers to understand limitations and risks before deciding whether to use any product.

aboutStory.title: Our Purpose: Awareness and Informed Choice
paragraphs: Cancer Herbalist was established to make people aware of our institute, our botanical products and the information available about them. We welcome patients and caregivers who want to ask questions and understand product ingredients, intended use, available documentation and practical considerations.

We believe people should have an open discussion before deciding whether to use a herbal or nutraceutical product. This includes discussing current cancer treatment, medicines, allergies, other health conditions, possible interactions, contraindications and areas where evidence is limited.

Herbal products are not substitutes for cancer diagnosis, surgery, chemotherapy, radiotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy or other care recommended by an oncology team. We do not claim that our products cure or treat cancer, shrink tumours, extend survival or prevent recurrence. Please discuss any product with your treating oncologist before use.
highlights: Information about botanical products and ingredients
Opportunity to discuss questions in person or by telephone
Clear explanation of limitations and potential risks
Respect for conventional oncology care and informed decisions
aboutStory.founderQuote: An informed decision begins with an honest conversation.

aboutMission.title: Mission & Vision
aboutMission.subtitle: Two guiding stars that shape every decision we make.
aboutMission.missionText: To improve public awareness of Cancer Herbalist, explain our botanical and nutraceutical products transparently, and provide opportunities for patients and caregivers to discuss intended use, limitations and potential risks before making decisions.
aboutMission.visionText: To be a transparent and accessible source of information about botanical products and complementary wellness, encouraging informed conversations and coordination with qualified healthcare professionals.

aboutValues.title: Our Core Values
aboutValues.subtitle: These principles are not aspirational — they are the living standards by which every practitioner at Cancer Herbalist operates, every day.

items.title: Compassionate Care
items.desc: Every patient is treated like family. We listen deeply, respond with empathy, and walk beside you through every step of your healing journey.

items.title: Evidence-Based Science
items.desc: Our herbal protocols are grounded in peer-reviewed research, clinical studies, and decades of integrative oncology practice — not guesswork.

items.title: Safety First, Always
items.desc: Every formula is screened for drug-herb interactions and contraindications. Transparency with your oncology team is non-negotiable.

items.title: Continuous Innovation
items.desc: Our research team continuously reviews the latest phytotherapy literature so your protocol reflects the most current science available.

items.title: Holistic Wellness
items.desc: We treat the whole person — body, mind, and spirit — through herbal medicine, nutrition coaching, and emotional wellbeing support.

items.title: Accessible to All
items.desc: Whether you are in Bangalore or abroad, our teleconsultation platform brings world-class integrative oncology support to your home.

items.title: Clinic Founded
items.desc: Following a remarkable recovery in one of our early brain cancer patients, we expanded our mission by opening our first integrative herbal oncology clinic in Bangalore.

items.title: Clinical Recognition
items.desc: Recognized by integrative medicine bodies for developing standardized, evidence-informed herbal support protocols for cancer patients.

items.title: Research Wing Opens
items.desc: Established a dedicated botanical research laboratory to study herbal formulations, bioavailability, and drug-herb interactions.

items.title: Global Teleconsultation
items.desc: Launched our digital consultation platform, enabling patients across India and internationally to access our specialized care remotely.

items.title: Integrative Team Grows
items.desc: Expanded our multidisciplinary team of herbalists, nutritionists, and integrative oncologists to serve a wider range of cancer types.

items.title: Two Decades of Healing
items.desc: Celebrating 20 years of service — continuing to refine our protocols, train new practitioners, and deepen our commitment to patient wellbeing.

items.title: Continuing Our Mission
items.desc: Building on years of experience by supporting patients at every stage of their cancer journey with compassionate integrative care.

aboutFounderProfile.title: Meet the Founder
aboutFounderProfile.subtitle: The Person Behind the Practice
aboutFounderProfile.name: Prof. Ramesh Babu
paragraphs: He spends one to two hours with every patient — compared to the industry average of 5 minutes. Not because he has to. Because he believes that no meaningful healing conversation can happen in a fraction of that time.

Prof. Ramesh Babu uses conventional treatment every day. He is not against it. He has seen it save lives. But he also sees what it leaves behind — fatigue, fear, and a body that needs more than a prescription to recover.

That conviction is why Cancer Herbalist was built the way it was — unhurried, deeply personal, and rooted in the belief that the body's own intelligence, properly supported, is one of the most powerful healing forces in medicine.
aboutFounderProfile.quote: Your immune system deserves a real conversation — not a footnote in a 15-minute appointment.

treatmentMethodsHero.title: Understand the
treatmentMethodsHero.subline: We provide information about botanical and nutraceutical products and encourage open questions about ingredients, intended use, evidence, limitations and potential risks.

treatmentMethodsPhilosophy.title: Product Transparency
treatmentMethodsPhilosophy.desc: We aim to explain product ingredients, formulation details, directions, labelling and available quality documentation. Ask us for documents relevant to a product.

treatmentMethodsPhilosophy.title: Evidence in Context
treatmentMethodsPhilosophy.desc: Laboratory findings, traditional use and human clinical studies are different kinds of evidence. We do not present laboratory research or individual experiences as proof of clinical benefit.

treatmentMethodsPhilosophy.title: Conventional Oncology Care
treatmentMethodsPhilosophy.desc: Our products are not cancer treatments and must not replace or delay care recommended by an oncologist, including surgery, chemotherapy, radiotherapy, immunotherapy or targeted therapy.

treatmentMethodsPhilosophy.title: Possible Interactions
treatmentMethodsPhilosophy.desc: Herbal ingredients can interact with medicines or be unsuitable in certain health conditions. Discuss all supplements with your oncologist or pharmacist before use.

treatmentMethodsPhilosophy.title: Individual Considerations
treatmentMethodsPhilosophy.desc: Age, diagnosis, treatment plan, organ function, allergies, pregnancy, surgery and other medicines can affect product suitability. No product is suitable for everyone.

treatmentMethodsPhilosophy.title: Informed Conversations
treatmentMethodsPhilosophy.desc: Patients and caregivers can contact us in person or by telephone to ask questions and understand the limitations and risks before deciding whether to proceed.

treatmentMethodsJourney.title: Initial Discussion
treatmentMethodsJourney.desc: Tell us what information you are looking for. We can explain the institute, available products and how to arrange a discussion.

treatmentMethodsJourney.title: Review Product Information
treatmentMethodsJourney.desc: Ask for the ingredient list, label directions, intended use and available quality documents for the specific product.
treatmentMethodsJourney.detail: Ask us which documents are available for the product you are considering.

treatmentMethodsJourney.title: Discuss Your Health Context
treatmentMethodsJourney.desc: Share relevant medicines, allergies, diagnoses and current cancer treatment if you wish. This helps identify questions that should be referred to your treating clinician.
treatmentMethodsJourney.detail: Your oncologist or pharmacist should assess medical suitability and interactions.

treatmentMethodsJourney.title: Understand Limitations & Risks
treatmentMethodsJourney.desc: Discuss evidence gaps, possible interactions, contraindications, precautions and uncertainty. No benefit or outcome is guaranteed.
treatmentMethodsJourney.detail: Do not stop or change prescribed treatment based on a product discussion.

treatmentMethodsJourney.title: Decide Without Pressure
treatmentMethodsJourney.desc: Take the information to your treating oncology team and make an informed decision. There is no obligation to purchase or use a product.
treatmentMethodsJourney.detail: Cancer Herbalist products are not substitutes for cancer treatment.

doctorsHero.title: Meet Our Expert Team
doctorsHero.subtitle: Our multidisciplinary team of medical consultants, naturopaths, and botanical researchers is dedicated to providing comprehensive, personalized care for cancer patients.

doctorsList.name: Prof. Ramesh Babu
doctorsList.bio: Prof. Ramesh is a highly accomplished Pharmacologist with a strong academic background and extensive experience in the field of herbal medicine. He holds a Master of Pharmacy (M.Pharm) and a PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, demonstrating his deep expertise in natural products and integrative oncology. With over two decades of dedicated practice, he has made significant contributions to herbal formulation and patient-centric cancer care.

doctorsList.name: Nutraceutical Team
doctorsList.specialty: Clinical Nutrition, Herbal Research & Patient Support
doctorsList.bio: Comprised of dedicated professionals from diverse medical, research, and healthcare backgrounds, our team works collaboratively to deliver comprehensive care and personalized support to every patient. By combining clinical expertise, evidence-based practices, and a patient-centered approach, we strive to address each individual's unique needs throughout their treatment journey.
